chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his father, who said:

Abū Ḥamzah prepared food for us while we were a group. When they were present, Abū Ḥamzah saw a man intensely gnawing a bone, so he shouted at him and said: Do not do that, for indeed I heard ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام saying:
Do not gnaw the bones excessively, for indeed the jinn have a share in them. If you do that, there will depart from the house that which is better for you than that.

key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the household or home from which blessing may depart
key_terms.الْجِنِّ: the jinn, who are said here to have a share in the bones
key_terms.الْعِظَامَ: bones, specifically the remains of food
key_terms.يَنْهَكُ: to gnaw or strip intensely and excessively

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام say about gnawing bones excessively?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette related to eating, specifically prohibiting excessive gnawing of bones. It explains that the jinn have a share in them, and warns that violating this etiquette causes something better than that to leave one's home.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4230 - It is narrated from Ali ibn Asbat, from his father, who said:

"Abu Hamzah prepared food for us while we were a group. When the food was served, Abu Hamzah noticed a man excessively gnawing on a bone.
He shouted at him and said: 'Do not do that! For I heard Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) say:
'Do not excessively gnaw on bones, for the jinn have a share in them. And if you do so, something better for you than that will depart from your house.'"
